names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιος Σωφρόνιος», with the rank word left off. The line gives him no epithet and no see; the English form carries the day, because this corpus holds several of the name.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

feast.note: saint.gr says where it gets him and how thin the ground is: «Δεν υπάρχουν πληροφορίες για τη ζωή του Οσίου. Η μνήμη του αναφέρεται από τον Παρισινό Κώδικα 1578 και τον Delehaye, όπου καλείται επίσκοπος» — there is no information about the venerable one's life; his memory is mentioned by the Paris Codex 1578 and by Delehaye, where he is called bishop (https://www.saint.gr/3756/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). The rank in this folder is that mention and nothing else.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Σωφρόνιος»
